g.text: Share of villages and care facilities with a checked route, by departure time
Dotted, with boxed count = window-limited: even the fastest fire-free trip + the 120 s stay would end after the 1-hour scenario window,
so no route could be checked whatever the fire. At +50 min only places within 8 min (480 s) of a destination can be checked.
Solid ink or grey = no checked route although a fire-free trip would fit the window (fire scenarios, model limits or an unresolved check).

Model-relative results for recorded 2025 fire scenarios (4 scenario members per input time, drawn per cell from the forecast; 1-hour scenario window; OSM roads at an assumed 40 km/h, no congestion). Each place is

checked to one of its three nearest OSM-mapped schools or community halls (not official shelters; for one Yeongdeok place one of the three is an unnamed OSM amenity=shelter point). Not evacuation outcomes.
Planning aid only - not for live evacuation operations.
